findings.description: store.project() is called for every timesheet entry, even though only a few distinct projects exist. If the store hits a database or file, this is one query per entry for a period with thousands of entries, which slows the report badly.
findings.suggestion: Only look up a project when its id is not already in `projects`, or fetch all needed projects in one batch call after the loop, as is done for employees.
